Gitignored files were never inventoried. `git worktree remove` deletes ignored files, and the ledger's status check (--untracked-files=normal) does not show them. Every REMOVED worktree in this log therefore also lost its gitignored files (patterns include __pycache__/, *.pyc, *.log, **/results/, **/reports/, *.db, *.pt). Measured for Ananke's archived scratch only: 418 files found before the commit, 294 committed under the archive tag, so 124 ignored files were deleted, most likely __pycache__/.pytest_cache from copied package and test trees (inferred, not verified). Nestor's receipt #1310 declared its gitignored *.log/*.pkl intentionally left. No other seat was asked about ignored files.
